I ran `crimes scan --format json`: **39 findings—5 high, 17 medium, 17 low**. Local ordering and scores differ because this checkout has no recorded churn; the table uses **your supplied IDs and scores**.

Severity and `scores.agent_risk` guide priority, but concrete impact determines the category. All findings are newly introduced against the empty baseline. “Ignore” means the reported concern does not warrant action on current evidence.

| Finding | Severity / agent_risk | Category | Justification |
|---|---|---|---|
| crime_00001 — Clock reads, dates | medium / 0.45 | warn | Highest reported agent risk; hidden clock dependence complicates expiry and weekend tests. No incorrect expiry comparison established. |
| crime_00002 — Return shapes | low / 0.44 | warn | Relatively high agent risk despite low severity: payment results lack a consistent discriminator. Define an explicit result union. |
| crime_00003 — Missing agent context | medium / 0.43 | warn | Useful maintenance improvement, not a runtime defect. Commands are partly discoverable through the manifest and existing docs. |
| crime_00004 — Scattered `enterprise` | medium / 0.43 | warn | Shared vocabulary can drift. Confirm shared policy before centralising; repeated strings alone do not demonstrate inconsistent behaviour. |
| crime_00005 — Mixed UTC/local dates | high / 0.39 | **block merge** | Confirmed correctness defect in `dateLabel`: UTC year combines with local month/day. The expression produces `2026-11-31` for a January 1 UTC instant in Los Angeles. |
| crime_00006 — Duplicate navigation | medium / 0.39 | warn | Competing “Plans”/“Billing” labels increase maintenance risk, but both point to the same destination. |
| crime_00007 — Route metadata drift | medium / 0.39 | warn | Conflicting titles deserve alignment; different route, component and display names are not inherently broken. |
| crime_00008 — Options bag | low / 0.39 | ignore | False premise: `describeCheckout` already accepts an explicit `CheckoutOptions` interface with six required fields. |

| crime_00015 — Rule only in comment | medium / 0.35 | warn | The ownership/support policy lacks executable enforcement. However, this function does not execute a refund, so the finding alone does not prove an authorisation bypass. |
| crime_00016 — DST arithmetic | medium / 0.33 | warn | Adding 24 hours changes local noon to 13:00 across spring DST. Define whether `tomorrowMs` promises elapsed time or the same local time tomorrow. |
| crime_00017 — Hardcoded localhost | medium / 0.31 | **block merge** | `adminUrl()` always returns the development host. Nonlocal users receive a URL targeting their own machine. Configure the destination. |

| crime_00022 — Default locale | low / 0.29 | ignore | Runtime-default localisation can be appropriate for `prettyDueDate`. No fixed-locale or serialisation requirement is established. |

| crime_00024 — Subscription route orphan | low / 0.29 | warn | Confirm its entry point. Missing in-repo links do not prove a route cannot be reached directly. |
| crime_00025 — Team route orphan | low / 0.29 | warn | Verify intended navigation; absence of static references is insufficient evidence for deletion or blocking. |
| crime_00026 — Members route orphan | low / 0.29 | warn | Check discoverability and external/deep-link entry points before wiring up or retiring it. |
| crime_00027 — Assertion-free test | medium / 0.28 | warn | Calls an empty helper and protects no behaviour. Replace with an observable assertion against real code. |
| crime_00028 — Commented-out code | medium / 0.27 | warn | Stale refund logic can mislead edits but does not execute. Review the existing suppression rationale before cleanup. |
| crime_00029 — Broken documentation link | low / 0.25 | warn | Confirmed missing setup guide impedes onboarding; repair the link or supply the document. |
| crime_00030 — Weak invoice test | low / 0.24 | warn | Worse than merely a weak matcher: it checks a local stub returning a constant object, not invoice generation. |
